message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Address | Phone | Pet Policy | Notes | |---------|---------|-------|------------|-------| | **Miami Central Station (formerly Miami Intermodal Center)** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | (305) 284‑4000 | **Pets allowed in carriers** (both on Tri‑Rail and Amtrak). | • The station is the main hub for Tri‑Rail, Amtrak, and the new Brightline service.
• Pets must be in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• No separate pet‑friendly lounge, but the station’s open‑air design and ample seating make it easy to keep your pet comfortable.
• The station is fully ADA‑accessible and offers free Wi‑Fi, restrooms, and a small café. | ### How to Use the Station with Your Pet 1. **Check the Carrier Rules** - **Tri‑Rail**: Pets must be in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area. The carrier must be secure and not exceed 20 lb. - **Amtrak**: Similar rules apply; carriers must be in the luggage area or under the seat. - **Brightline**: Pets are allowed in carriers on the Brightline trains that stop at Miami Central. 2. **Plan Your Route** - **Tri‑Rail**: Runs from Miami to West Palm Beach. Check the schedule on the Tri‑Rail website. - **Amtrak**: Offers long‑distance service to cities like New York, Washington, and Chicago. - **Brightline**: Provides service to Fort Lauderdale and West Palm Beach (and will expand to Orlando). 3. **Arrive Early** - Give yourself extra time to navigate the station with your pet, especially if you’re traveling during peak hours. 4. **Keep Your Pet Calm** - Use a familiar carrier, bring a favorite blanket or toy, and keep your pet’s food and water in a separate bag. 5. **After the Train** - The station has a small café (Café 1) where you can grab a quick snack. While the café itself doesn’t have a dedicated pet area, you can keep your pet in the carrier while you order. ### Contact & Resources - **Station Website**: [Miami Central Station](https://www.miamicentralstation.com) - **Tri‑Rail**: [Tri‑Rail Pet Policy](https://www.tri-rail.com/faq/pets) - **Amtrak**: [Amtrak Pet Policy](https://www.amtrak.com/pets) - **Brightline**: [Brightline Pet Policy](https://www.thebrightline.com/pets) --- **Quick Tip:** If you’re traveling with a dog that’s not in a carrier, you’ll need to check the specific train’s pet policy. Most services only allow pets in carriers, so plan accordingly. Enjoy your trip, and safe travels with your furry friend!
